rated_messages.input_message: Pause. Notice what triggered you to smoke in the past. Now take one deep breath and remind yourself that you do not need to smoke.
Pause. Notice what triggered you to smoke in the past. Now take one deep breath and remind yourself that you do not need to smoke.
Each time you choose to not smoke after seeing someone else light up, you lessen the habit a little more.

Write down why you want to stop smoking to resist a craving. Remember, trying something to beat the urge is always better than doing nothing. Each time you resist a cig, you're one step closer to being tobacco-free.
Take a minute to notice what the urge feels like in your body without smoking a cigarette. Notice what is going on. See what happens. Does the urge pass?
Keep picturing yourself getting home later today knowing that you've gained a smoke-free day. It's nearly a reality!
Practice going 10 minutes without smoking. Think of it just as practice. When the urge passes, reward yourself with a break from work or dinner from your favorite restaurant!
If you usually smoke while you talk on the phone, keep a pen and paper nearby to occupy your hands with doodling rather than smoking.
Instead of smoking, think of 3 things from today that you are grateful for. These can be anything, even small things! Now ask yourself, why are you grateful for these things?
Instead of lighting up a cigarette, light a scented candle or burn some incense.

Think about your hero, or someone you admire. What do you admire about them? Often our heroes are people who struggle and succeed in difficult circumstances. Now's the chance to be your own hero - by not smoking despite the challenges of stress and strong urges!
